blockers: The checked-in powers catalog marks county payroll tax as may=no in its game profile and says state or federal law sets this tax.
Because the county has no supported decision authority, the policy-pack builder omits this county payroll question and does not load a consequence row.
The shared local payroll producer can assess a saved local tax only when an operative supported proposal exists; a producer alone does not establish county taxing authority.
The common tax consequence reader assesses saved payer bases, but no producer maps county corporate tax to a person-level taxable occurrence.
The business-owner research request says no private business has a recorded owner, balance, revenue or owner income, so the incidence cannot be assigned to named people without inventing ownership.
The corporate-incidence summary does not provide recorded owners or ownership shares for named local business owners.
The checked-in authority request says the 56-place survey is incomplete; the production fiscal-authority corpus does not currently establish city income-tax authority nationwide.
A city income-tax consequence must remain inactive unless the saved government and adopted terms pass the shared authority binding.
No complete record identifies where city income taxes are authorized, their effective dates, rate caps or resident credits.
